basic_details.job_title: Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme (July 2027 Course)
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Army has published a bilingual (Hindi and English) notice titled "Join Indian Army as an Officer" inviting applications under the 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme. The notice refers candidates to the official website for the detailed notification.

important_dates.other dates: Not specified in the provided notice

age_limit.details: The age limit for Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026 is 16.5 to 19.5 years. The age will be calculated as of 01.07.2027.

qualification.details: The notice states two conditions for the TES-57 course: JEE (Mains) 2026 is mandatory, and this is in addition to the criterion of minimum 60% marks in PCM in Class 12. Any other eligibility condition, such as nationality, marital status or medical standards, is not mentioned in the notice, so candidates should read the detailed notification before applying. | requirement: Details | class 12 marks: Minimum 60% marks in PCM (Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics) in Class 12 | entrance examination: JEE (Mains) 2026 is mandatory

how_to_apply: The notice mentions only that applications are online. Based on it, candidates can follow these points:
Check that you meet the notice conditions: JEE (Mains) 2026 and a minimum of 60% marks in PCM in Class 12.
Read the detailed notification available on the website.
Submit the online application between 14 October 2026 and 12 November 2026.
Step-by-step registration instructions, required documents and the final submission process are not given in the notice.
important_instructions: Recruitment in the Army is totally transparent and free. Beware of touts. For the detailed notification, visit www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Commissioned Officer (10+2 TES-57 Course) is conducted by the Indian Army for eligible male candidates aspiring to join the defense sector through the technical entry scheme.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Commissioned Officer under the 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme (TES)-57 Course for candidates who meet the specified educational criteria.

faq.question: Q3. When does the online application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process for the Indian Army Commissioned Officer (10+2 TES-57 Course) officially starts on 14 October 2026, allowing candidates to submit their applications online.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to successfully submit the online application form for this recruitment is 12 November 2026. Candidates are advised to complete their applications well before the closing date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10+2 or equivalent examination with a minimum of 60% marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM). Additionally, appearing in JEE Mains 2026 is mandatory.

faq.question: Q6. Is JEE Mains score required for this entry?
faq.answer: Yes, appearing in JEE Mains 2026 is a mandatory requirement for all applicants applying for the 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme (TES)-57 Course conducted by the Indian Army.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can apply online by visiting the official website of the Indian Army at www.joinindianarmy.nic.in during the active application window specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee details are mentioned in the official notification, meaning candidates can generally submit their applications without any fee payment as per standard TES guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for Indian Army recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website to check notifications, updates, and submit online applications for Indian Army recruitments is www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by visiting the Important Links section in this article and clicking on the designated link provided for the notification.
